_note: Per-model settings for scripts/multiagent.py --models-file (and scripts/cost_estimate.py). context = tokens used to size the code budget (the smallest in a run decides; 40% of it goes to code: 156k tokens when gpt-5.4-mini is in the run, which leaves orjson CVE-2024-27454 (about 181k with its C library) in excerpts; about 396k with the v2 models, every case whole; every request stays under the 272K input tokens above which OpenAI doubles the price); max_output = output budget (reasoning models think inside it); price_* = USD per 1M tokens, OpenAI Standard list prices (Nov 2026), used only for the printed cost estimate (no discount for cached input or Flex); flex = the model offers OpenAI's Flex tier at half price (OpenAI: unavailable on GPT-6.2 Astra and GPT-6.2 Sol, not added to future models; not stated for gpt-5.4-mini). With --openai-extra '{"service_tier": "flex"}', a model that rejects it, or a Flex request that keeps getting 429 (no capacity), goes on at the Standard tier and the drop is recorded. NVIDIA-hosted models (optional; free, about 40 requests/min): context set conservatively to 128k. v2 (Nov 25, 2026): anthropic:* = Claude through the official Anthropic SDK (anthropic==2.14.0), reasoning_effort -> output_config.effort, thinking adaptive (the default on Claude 5.5), no temperature; list prices from platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing (Haiku 5.5: 0.10/0.50 up to 100k prompt tokens, 0.50/2.50 above). deepseek:* = DeepSeek's own OpenAI-compatible API (api.deepseek.com), thinking on, reasoning_effort none|low|high|max (high = its default), max_tokens up to 384K (64K = its thinking-mode default); prices are the cache-miss peak prices (01-04 and 06-10 UTC on weekdays), half off-peak (api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/pricing). claudecode:* (Nov 25, 2026, plan v2 option B) = the same Claude models through the Claude Code CLI (claude -p) with the Claude plan instead of the API: one fresh session per call, no tools, no MCP, the role's system prompt replacing Claude Code's, reasoning_effort -> --effort; max_output is not used (Claude Code's own output limit); not billed: the prices only give the API-equivalent cost, which Claude Code itself reports per call. Sonnet at medium: in the Claude Code juror pilot (5 cases, 28 patches) it judged as well as high (AUROC 0.97 both) with half the tokens and time.
